S: Rodeo Drive bacon and gruyère quiches
Axel crashing the Beverly Hills party circuit

Bite-size shortcrust cases filled with smoky bacon, caramelised onion, gruyère and a just-set egg custard, finished with chives. Heat the oven to 180C. Cut 24 rounds from 3 sheets of shortcrust pastry and press into mini muffin trays. Fry 3 diced bacon rashers with 1 thinly sliced onion for 10 minutes until golden and divide between the cases with 80g grated gruyère. Whisk 3 eggs with 200ml cream, salt and pepper, pour into the cases and bake 15 minutes until just set. Top with snipped chives.
Baby vegetables with a creamy herb and anchovy dip
Baby carrots, radishes, cucumber and sugar snaps on ice with green goddess dressing (mayo, sour cream, parsley, tarragon, chives, anchovy, lemon).
Potato and cheese pierogi fried in butter with onions, a taste of Detroit
Potato and cheese dumplings boiled then pan-fried in butter with onions, sour cream on the side.
Crisp tortillas with refried beans, cheddar and jalapeños, salsa and sour cream

Flour tortillas filled with refried beans, melted cheddar and jalapeños, toasted in a dry pan until crisp, cut into wedges with salsa and sour cream. Spread 4 flour tortillas with 400g refried beans, scatter with 200g grated cheddar and sliced pickled jalapeños, then fold in half. Toast in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down, until crisp and the cheese melts. Cut into wedges and serve with 200g tomato salsa and 150g sour cream.
Baked pastry turnovers filled with smoky chicken, egg and olives
Golden shortcrust half moons filled with cumin and paprika chicken, chopped boiled egg and green olives, baked until crisp. The kind Enrique packs for the run to the border.

M: Smoky pork ribs, corn and potato salad
Paprika rubbed ribs baked then glazed, charred corn, Dijon potato salad
Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, wrapped and baked at 150C for 2.5 hours, unwrapped and glazed under a hot grill. Charred corn, potato salad with mustard dressing.
Double smashed beef patties, American cheese, pickles and burger sauce on toasted brioche

The Fourth of July cookout Captain Hiller never got to, off the grill and stacked high. Divide 800g beef mince into 8 balls. Mix 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp mustard, 1 tbsp tomato sauce and chopped pickle for the sauce. Toast 4 buttered brioche buns cut side down. Smash the balls flat on a very hot greased flat plate or pan, season and cook 2 minutes, flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute more. Stack two patties on each bun with sauce, lettuce, tomato, red onion and pickles.

W: Apples dipped in red hard toffee, served with a bag of fairy floss

Crisp apples on sticks dipped in glassy red toffee that cracks when you bite it, with a bag of fairy floss on the side. Push sticks into 4 apples. Boil 400g sugar, 125ml water and 1 tsp vinegar to 150C, then add a few drops of red colouring. Dip and twirl the apples and set on baking paper. Serve with a bag of fairy floss.

S: Dry-brined pork rind roasted until blistered and crisp, with flaky salt
Pork rind scored, salted and dried in the fridge overnight, roasted at 240C for 30 minutes until blistered and crisp, broken into pieces.
Soft boiled eggs wrapped in sausage, crumbed and fried, with English mustard
Eggs boiled 6 minutes, peeled, wrapped in seasoned sausage mince, rolled in flour, egg and panko, fried at 170C for 7 minutes. Hot English mustard.
David wakes up naked in the wolf enclosure at the zoo

Almonds, cashews and peanuts roasted in egg white, brown sugar, rosemary and cayenne until crunchy, with a scatter of flaky salt. Whisk 1 egg white until frothy. Toss with 150g almonds, 150g cashews and 150g peanuts. Mix 60g brown sugar, 1 tbsp chopped rosemary, half a tsp cayenne and 1 tsp salt and toss through. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 150C for 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes. Cool completely so they crisp, then sprinkle with flaky salt.
M: Haddock in crisp ale batter with thick-cut chips, minty mushy peas and malt vinegar

Eat it here by the fire. Whatever you do, stay off the moors and keep clear of the moon. Cut 1kg floury potatoes into thick chips, simmer 5 minutes, drain and dry. Fry at 160C for 6 minutes, rest, then fry again at 190C until crisp. Whisk 200g self-raising flour with 300ml cold pale ale and a pinch of salt. Dip 4 haddock fillets in a little flour, then the batter, and fry at 180C for 5 to 6 minutes until golden. Simmer 500g frozen peas 5 minutes and crush with butter, chopped mint and salt. Serve with lemon and malt vinegar.
Lamb mince in tomato and Worcestershire gravy under baked mashed potato
Lamb mince browned with onion, carrot, tomato paste, Worcestershire and stock, simmered 40 minutes, topped with buttery mash and baked at 200C until golden.
Pork chops simmered in Tassie cider with apple, onion and sage, over mash with buttered beans
Pork chops browned, then simmered with Tassie cider, apples, onion and sage for 20 minutes. Served on mash with buttered green beans.
fish in a batter made with the beer he put bubbles in

Flathead in an extra-crisp beer and rice flour batter with chunky chips, lemon and a tartare sauce full of capers and gherkins. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, fry at 140C for 6 minutes, then 190C for 3 minutes. Whisk 120g plain flour, 60g rice flour, 1 tsp baking powder and salt with 300ml ice-cold beer until just combined. Dust 4 flathead fillets in flour, dip and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until crisp. Mix 150g mayonnaise with chopped gherkins, capers, parsley and lemon juice. Serve with lemon wedges.
W: Granny Smith apple pie with cinnamon, served warm with cream
Granny Smiths with sugar and cinnamon in a double crust, baked at 190C for 50 minutes. Cream.

S: Smoky South African relish of peppers, carrot, beans and chilli, with charred bread

The relish that turns up at every braai, warm, smoky and no worries for the rest of your days. Soften a diced onion in 2 tbsp oil with 2 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp ginger and a chopped red chilli. Add a diced red and green capsicum and 2 grated carrots and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tsp curry powder and 1 tsp smoked paprika, then a tin of diced tomatoes and a tin of baked beans. Simmer 15 minutes until thick. Serve warm or at room temperature with charred Turkish bread and coriander.
a nod to Southern African street food

Lamb cubes marinated overnight in apricot jam, curry and vinegar, skewered with dried apricots and onion, grilled sticky and charred. Mix 3 tbsp apricot jam, 1 tbsp mild curry powder, 2 tbsp vinegar, 1 grated onion and salt. Toss with 800g diced lamb leg and marinate overnight. Thread onto 8 skewers with 100g dried apricots and wedges of 1 onion. Grill over high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning and brushing with the leftover marinade, until charred and just pink inside.
Mango, papaya, pineapple and passionfruit with lime, chilli salt and mint
Wedges of mango, papaya, pineapple and passionfruit on ice, with lime, a pinch of chilli salt and fresh mint.
M: Nala and the lionesses bring home dinner

Butterflied chicken marinated in charred chilli, garlic, lemon and paprika, roasted until crackling, with yellow rice and a cooling mango salsa. Blitz 2 red chillies (seeded for kids), 4 garlic cloves, the juice of 1 lemon, 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp oregano, 60ml oil and salt. Rub over a butterflied 1.8kg chicken and marinate overnight. Roast at 220C for 45 minutes until 75C in the thigh. Cook 300g rice with half a tsp turmeric. Dice 1 mango with red onion, coriander and lime for salsa.
South African spiced beef bake with curry, chutney and an egg custard topping
Beef mince cooked with onion, curry powder, turmeric, chutney and soaked bread, topped with egg and milk custard and bay leaves, baked at 180C for 35 minutes.
W: Chocolate mousse with crushed cookie dirt, gummy worms and a mint leaf
Gummy worms buried in cups of dark chocolate mousse with crushed chocolate biscuit dirt, a mint leaf on top.
Cardamom coconut doughnut triangles, fried and dusted with icing sugar

Coconut and cardamom dough rested an hour, cut into triangles, fried at 170C until puffed and golden, dusted with icing sugar. Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 80g sugar, 1 tsp cardamom and 250ml warm coconut milk to a soft dough and rest an hour. Roll out, cut into triangles and fry at 170C until puffed and golden. Dust with icing sugar.

S: Mature cheddar, pork pie, pickled onions, chutney, apple and crusty bread

Thick slices of mature cheddar, pork pie, pickled onions, a chunky brown pickle, apple and crusty bread with salted butter on a wooden board. Take 250g mature cheddar out of the fridge an hour ahead and cut into thick slices. Cut a pork pie into wedges. Arrange on a board with pickled onions, chutney, a sliced apple, crusty bread and a dish of salted butter.
Village of the Year fete scotch eggs
Soft boiled eggs wrapped in sausage, crumbed and fried, with English mustard

Eggs boiled 6 minutes, peeled, wrapped in seasoned sausage mince, rolled in flour, egg and panko, fried at 170C for 7 minutes. Boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Wrap each in 100g seasoned sausage mince. Roll in flour, 1 beaten egg and 100g panko. Fry at 170C for 7 minutes, halve and serve with English mustard.
Greater good cheddar and leek rarebit
Mature cheddar, English mustard and soft leek bubbling on thick sourdough toast

Served at every Neighbourhood Watch Alliance meeting, for the greater good. Soften a sliced leek in 30g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, then 100ml milk, and cook until thick. Off the heat beat in 250g grated mature cheddar, 2 tsp English mustard and an egg yolk. Toast 4 thick slices of sourdough, spread the cheese thickly to the edges and grill until bubbling and browned in spots. Cut into fingers and scatter with chives.
Steamed pork dumplings with garlic chives and ginger, soy and black vinegar
Pork and chive dumplings folded and steamed 8 minutes, with a soy and black vinegar dip. Tea poured carefully.
Crisp rolls of cabbage, shiitake, carrot and glass noodles with sweet chilli

Small, crisp and lucky, like the cricket Grandmother Fa tests by walking across the road with her eyes shut. Soak 100g rice vermicelli and snip short. Stir-fry a quarter of a wombok, 2 grated carrots and 150g sliced shiitake until wilted, add garlic chives, 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil, toss with the noodles and cool. Roll a spoonful in each of 20 spring roll wrappers, sealing with cornflour paste. Fry at 180C in batches until golden. Serve with sweet chilli sauce.
Wok tossed edamame with garlic, chilli and soy, finished with flaky salt
Edamame steamed 4 minutes, tossed in a hot wok with garlic, chilli flakes, a splash of soy and plenty of flaky salt.
M: Silky ginger rice porridge topped with fried egg and bacon
Jasmine rice simmered 90 minutes in chicken stock with ginger until silky, topped with a fried egg and bacon in a smiling face, spring onion and soy.
Chicken thighs braised glossy in soy, star anise and rock sugar, bok choy and rice

A feast-day braise for the night Mulan comes home a hero, sticky with soy, Shaoxing and rock sugar, with steamed bok choy and rice. Brown 8 chicken thigh pieces in oil, add ginger, spring onion, 2 star anise and a cinnamon stick, then 3 tbsp light soy, 2 tbsp dark soy, 3 tbsp Shaoxing wine, 40g rock sugar and 250ml water. Simmer covered 20 minutes, then uncovered until the sauce turns glossy. Steam 4 halved baby bok choy and serve with jasmine rice.
8 chicken thigh fillets, in large pieces@Meat
W: Golden baked pastry filled with sweet lotus seed paste

Golden syrup, oil and alkaline water mixed into flour and rested 2 hours, wrapped thinly around balls of lotus seed paste, pressed into moulds, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, egg washed and baked 10 more.

M: Sichuan pepper squid and egg fried rice
Crisp rice-flour squid with chilli and spring onion, jasmine rice fried with egg
Squid scored and cut, dusted in rice flour and Sichuan salt and pepper, fried at 190C for 60 seconds, tossed with chilli and spring onion, with egg fried rice.
Suburban Sunday roast pork and crackling
the family house out in the suburbs

Pork belly roasted until the crackling shatters, with crisp potatoes, honey pumpkin, apple sauce and gravy, the full Sydney Sunday spread. Score the skin of a 1.5kg pork belly, pat dry, rub with 1 tbsp salt and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast at 240C for 30 minutes, then 170C for 90 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes and 600g pumpkin drizzled with honey alongside for the last hour. Simmer 3 chopped apples with 2 tbsp sugar and water until soft for sauce. Make gravy with the pan juices, 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.

S: Grilled white miso and garlic chicken thigh skewers with a soy sesame dip
Chicken thighs marinated in miso and garlic, threaded on skewers and grilled until charred, served with a sesame dipping sauce.
Pan-fried mushroom, tofu and cabbage gyoza with soy, black vinegar and chilli oil

Crisp-bottomed dumplings off a noodle bar under the neon, filled with mushroom, tofu and salted wombok, real food in a city that mostly sells the look of it. Fry until crisp underneath, then steam. Serve with soy, black vinegar and chilli oil.
Wooden horse soft pretzels with mustard
the small wooden horse K carves into his memory

Soft pretzel twists dipped in bicarb water, sprinkled with rock salt and baked deep brown, served warm with a honey and wholegrain mustard dip. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Divide into 8, roll into long ropes and twist into pretzels. Boil 2L water with 60g bicarb soda and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds. Sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp wholegrain mustard with 2 tbsp honey to dip.
Pork and prawn wontons in ginger chicken broth with bok choy
Pork and prawn wontons folded and simmered in chicken stock with ginger and soy, loaded into bowls with bok choy so there are more wontons than soup.
Long crisp rolls of cabbage, shiitake and glass noodles, sweet chilli to dip

Packed tight and built long like one of Holtzmann's proton wands, and only slightly less likely to go off in your hands. Soak 100g rice vermicelli and snip short. Stir-fry a quarter of a wombok, 2 grated carrots, 150g sliced shiitake and 4 spring onions until wilted, add 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil, toss with the noodles and cool. Roll a spoonful tightly in each of 20 wrappers and seal with cornflour paste. Fry at 180C until golden and serve with sweet chilli sauce.
Avocado, edamame and lime dip with prawn crackers and cucumber sticks
Avocado, edamame, lime, garlic and coriander blitzed bright green, served with prawn crackers and cucumber sticks.
M: Zhu's sweet and sour chicken with egg fried rice
Crispy chicken tossed with pineapple and peppers, egg fried rice on the side
The kind of takeaway the Hunan place downstairs sends up, if they ever get the order right. Crisp cornflour-coated chicken thigh tossed in a tangy pineapple and capsicum sauce, with egg fried rice.
Times Square onion sauce hot dogs

All-beef franks griddled until split, in soft buns with spicy brown mustard, sweet onions stewed in tomato and a little chilli, and pickle relish. Slice 2 onions thinly and cook in oil over medium heat for 10 minutes until soft. Add 3 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tsp sugar, half a tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp vinegar and 150ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick and sticky. Griddle 8 all-beef franks until blistered and split. Warm 8 hot dog buns. Fill with franks, mustard, the onion sauce and a spoon of pickle relish.
W: Crisp vanilla cookies folded around paper fortunes
Thin batter of egg white, sugar, flour and vanilla baked at 180C in small rounds for 6 minutes, folded around a paper fortune while still hot.

M: Linguine with crab, garlic, chilli and lemon, topped with toasted breadcrumbs

Linguine tossed with sweet crab meat, garlic, a little chilli, lemon zest and parsley in good olive oil, finished with toasted breadcrumbs. Cook 400g linguine in well salted water. Toast 40g breadcrumbs in a little oil until golden. Gently fry 3 sliced garlic cloves and half a seeded red chilli in 80ml olive oil for 2 minutes. Add 300g crab meat, the zest and juice of a lemon and a ladle of pasta water and warm through. Toss with the drained pasta and chopped parsley, then scatter with the crumbs.
Jesse's park kiosk chilli cheese dogs
Franks in toasted rolls under beef and bean chilli, melted cheddar and spring onion

The hot dog Jesse would have nicked from the park kiosk before he started working there, loaded with a quick beef and bean chilli and plenty of cheddar. Fry a diced onion and 2 garlic cloves in oil, add 500g beef mince, 2 tsp chilli powder and 1 tsp cumin and brown well. Add a tin of crushed tomatoes and a tin of drained kidney beans and simmer 20 minutes until thick. Simmer 8 franks for 5 minutes. Split and toast 8 rolls, add a frank, spoon over the chilli and top with 150g grated cheddar and sliced spring onion. Grill a minute to melt.

S: Baguette spread with roast garlic, butter and parmesan, then baked
Baguette split and spread with butter packed with roasted garlic, parsley and parmesan, baked at 200C for 12 minutes until crisp.
Roasted beetroot blended with Greek yoghurt, garlic and cumin
Beetroot roasted in foil at 200C for an hour, peeled and blitzed with yoghurt, garlic, lemon and cumin until deep red, with warm pita crisps.
King prawns threaded on skewers and charred in a whole lot of garlic butter

Prawns on skewers like a row of Blade's silver stakes, grilled hard and basted in garlic, lemon and chilli butter, so nothing undead comes near the table. Soak 12 bamboo skewers. Thread 800g peeled green king prawns on them. Melt 60g butter with 6 crushed garlic cloves, the zest of a lemon and 1 tsp chilli flakes. Grill the skewers on a very hot pan or barbecue 2 minutes a side, brushing with the garlic butter. Finish with lemon juice and chopped parsley.
800g green king prawns, peeled with tails on@Seafood
Puff pastry rolls of pork mince, onion and sage
Sausage rolls of pork, onion and sage in puff pastry, baked at 200C for 25 minutes, with mustard.
Maximus's crisp apple and fennel salad
Shaved apple, fennel and celery with toasted walnuts, rocket, cheddar and honey mustard

A bowl of the palace horse's favourite thing, sliced thin and crisp enough to bribe him off Flynn's trail. Toast 80g walnuts in a dry pan. Whisk the juice of a lemon with 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp honey, 1 tsp wholegrain mustard and salt. Thinly slice 3 crisp red apples, a fennel bulb and a few inner celery stalks and toss straight into the dressing so the apple stays white. Fold through 100g rocket and the celery leaves, then top with the walnuts and shaved aged cheddar.
1 bunch celery, inner stalks and leaves@Produce
M: Potato and toasted hazelnut soup with celery
Toasted hazelnuts blended with onion, celery and potato simmered in chicken stock, finished with cream and topped with crushed hazelnuts and chives.
Flynn Rider trying out the smoulder

Chicken spatchcocked and rubbed with smoked paprika, garlic and lemon, roasted with a smoky char, over crispy potatoes with herby yoghurt. Cut out the backbone of a 1.8kg chicken and press flat. Rub with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 3 crushed garlic cloves, the zest of 1 lemon, olive oil and salt. Lay over 1kg sliced potatoes tossed in oil in a roasting tin and roast at 220C for 50 minutes until charred and cooked through. Rest 10 minutes. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with lemon juice, parsley and mint to serve.
W: Whole boiled orange and almond meal cake
Orange and almond cakes baked in muffin tins at 170C for 25 minutes, glazed with orange syrup and topped with a candied orange slice.
the lantern festival in the kingdom of Corona

Lemon cupcakes piped with lilac blueberry buttercream and topped with a golden sugar sun, the royal emblem of Corona. Beat 125g soft butter with 150g caster sugar, add 2 eggs, the zest of 1 lemon, 125ml milk and 200g self-raising flour. Spoon into 12 paper cases and bake at 175C for 18 minutes, then cool. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar and 2 tbsp blueberry jam until fluffy and lilac. Pipe onto the cakes and top each with a yellow fondant sun cut with a small cutter.

M: Creamy jasmine rice porridge with prawns, lemongrass, ginger and bamboo
Jasmine rice simmered in stock with lemongrass and ginger until creamy, topped with prawns, bamboo shoots, chilli and a little palm sugar.
Kumandra five lands beef noodle soup

Star anise and cinnamon beef broth poured over rice noodles and paper-thin raw beef, piled with herbs, bean sprouts, chilli, lime and hoisin. Char 1 halved onion and a 5cm piece of ginger in a dry pan. Simmer with 2L beef stock, 3 star anise, 1 cinnamon stick, 2 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tbsp sugar for 30 minutes, then strain. Freeze 300g sirloin for 30 minutes and slice paper thin. Soak 400g rice noodles and divide between bowls. Top with raw beef and pour over the boiling broth. Serve with bean sprouts, Thai basil, mint, chilli, lime and hoisin.
Mr Banks's chicken and leek pie
Chicken and leeks in a creamy thyme sauce under puff pastry, with buttered peas

Supper on the table at six o'clock precisely, the way Mr Banks likes his house run. Brown 800g chicken thigh chunks in butter, add 2 sliced leeks and soften. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then 300ml chicken stock, 150ml cream, 1 tbsp Dijon and thyme leaves, and simmer 10 minutes until thick. Cool a little, tip into a pie dish, top with a sheet of puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 to 30 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve with buttered peas.
Roast beef topside, Yorkshire puddings baked in muffin tins, roast potatoes
Beef topside roasted at 200C to medium, rested, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes, peas and gravy.
W: Raspberry and lemon ice scraped with a fork into flakes

Raspberries blended with sugar syrup and lemon, frozen and scraped every hour until fluffy, served in glass dishes with wafers. Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Blend 500g raspberries with the syrup and the juice of a lemon, then strain out the seeds. Freeze in a tray, scraping with a fork every hour for 4 hours. Serve in glass dishes with ice cream wafers.

S: Jaime's Nana and her family recipes

Masa spread on corn husks, filled with pork in red chilli sauce, steamed 90 minutes. Simmer 800g pork shoulder in water with onion and garlic for 2 hours, then shred. Blend 4 soaked guajillo chillies with 2 garlic cloves, cumin and 250ml of the cooking liquid and stir through the pork. Soak 16 corn husks in hot water for 30 minutes. Beat 150g lard or butter until fluffy, then beat in 400g masa harina, 2 tsp baking powder, salt and 500ml warm stock. Spread on the husks, add pork, fold up and steam standing for 90 minutes.
Charred corn with lime mayo, crumbled feta and chilli flakes
Corn cobs grilled until charred, brushed with mayo and lime, rolled in crumbled feta and dusted with chilli.
Chunky avocado, lime, jalapeño and coriander with hot chilli-salted tortilla chips

Milagro makes it chunky and roasts everyone while she does. Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 12 corn tortillas into wedges, toss in 3 tbsp oil and bake 10 to 12 minutes until crisp, then dust with Tajín. Mash 4 avocados roughly with the juice of 2 limes and salt, leaving big chunks. Fold through half a finely diced white onion, 2 diced tomatoes, a chopped jalapeño and a handful of coriander. Serve with the warm totopos.

M: Chicken in coconut green curry sauce served with jasmine rice

Chicken simmered in a fragrant green curry with coconut milk, Thai basil, snake beans and makrut lime, with jasmine rice and fresh chilli. Cook 1.5 cups jasmine rice. Fry 3 tbsp green curry paste in 2 tbsp of the thick top of 400ml coconut milk until fragrant. Add 800g sliced chicken thigh and stir 3 minutes. Pour in the rest of the coconut milk, 100ml stock, 4 torn makrut lime leaves, 1 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tsp palm sugar. Simmer 12 minutes, adding 150g snake beans for the last 5. Stir in Thai basil and serve with rice and sliced chilli.
Roommates' pepperoni and hot honey pizza
Pepperoni, jalapeños and mozzarella on a crisp base, chilli honey and rocket on top

What Ben and the boys order every night of the week, made properly for once. Heat the oven as high as it goes with two trays inside. Mix 250g passata with 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp oregano and salt. Stretch 1kg pizza dough into 4 bases on baking paper, spread with the sauce and top with 300g mozzarella, 150g pepperoni and sliced jalapeños. Slide onto the hot trays and bake 8 to 10 minutes until blistered. Warm 2 tbsp honey with 1 tsp chilli flakes and drizzle over, then finish with rocket and shaved parmesan.
Joe's crop field chicken salad bowl
Lemon chicken, grilled corn, cos, tomato and avocado, buttermilk dressing

Grilled lemon herb chicken over crisp cos, avocado, corn, cherry tomatoes and cucumber with a creamy buttermilk ranch dressing. Marinate 600g chicken breast in 2 tbsp olive oil, the zest and juice of 1 lemon, 1 crushed garlic clove and 1 tsp dried oregano for 20 minutes. Grill 6 minutes a side, rest and slice. Grill 2 corn cobs and cut off the kernels. Whisk 100ml buttermilk, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, chopped chives and dill. Toss 2 chopped cos lettuces, 250g halved cherry tomatoes, 1 sliced cucumber and 1 avocado. Top with chicken and corn and drizzle with dressing.
Beef and pork meatballs, provolone, toasted rolls

Built for a president who fires a machine gun to open a session, loud, oversized and dripping. Mix 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, 60g breadcrumbs, an egg, 40g parmesan, garlic, oregano and salt and roll into 16 big meatballs. Brown in oil, add 700g passata and simmer 20 minutes. Split and toast 4 sub rolls, fill with meatballs and sauce, lay over 2 slices of provolone each and grill until melted. Finish with torn basil and a handful of rocket.
Beef patty, Swiss cheese and fried onions on grilled rye
A patty melt on rye with Swiss cheese and fried onions, old-school diner food Pops would order.
Sticky grilled chicken thighs, buttered corn and slaw

Sam on the barbecue while the payback jobs wait in the fridge with the beer. Rub 8 chicken thighs with oil, 2 tsp smoked paprika and salt. Simmer 250ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp cider vinegar and 1 tbsp brown sugar for 5 minutes. Grill the chicken over medium heat 6 to 7 minutes a side, brushing with the sauce for the last few minutes until sticky and charred. Grill 4 corn cobs, turning, and roll in butter. Shred a quarter cabbage, a carrot and half a red onion and toss with 100g mayonnaise, a splash of vinegar and salt.
Pepperoni, ham, bacon and Italian sausage pizza on barbecue sauce

A loaded meat lovers pizza with smoky barbecue base, pepperoni, ham, bacon, Italian sausage and mozzarella, baked until crisp and blistered. Stretch 750g pizza dough into two 30cm rounds on oiled trays. Mix 100ml pizza sauce with 3 tbsp barbecue sauce and spread over the bases. Scatter with 300g grated mozzarella. Top with 100g pepperoni, 100g chopped ham, 3 rashers chopped bacon and 2 Italian sausages, squeezed from the skins in small pieces. Bake at 240C for 12 to 14 minutes until the crust is golden and the meat is crisp.
Buttermilk fried chicken with a peppery crust, creamy slaw and hot sauce

The bucket Rusty fries all day while Willard plans the job, crunchy, peppery and juicy right through. Soak 1.2kg chicken pieces in 500ml buttermilk with 2 tsp hot sauce and salt for at least 4 hours. Mix 250g flour with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp cayenne, salt and pepper. Dredge the chicken, pressing to get a shaggy crust. Fry at 160C for 12 to 14 minutes, turning, until cooked through, then drain on a rack. Shred red and green cabbage and a carrot and toss with 100g mayonnaise, 1 tbsp cider vinegar and salt. Serve with hot sauce.

S: Chipotle prawns, charred corn, feta and lime crema in corn tortillas

Chipotle prawn tacos with charred corn, cotija-style feta, pickled red onion, lime crema and coriander in warm corn tortillas, a taste of Phoenix for a girl from the North Pole. Slice 1 red onion and soak in the juice of 2 limes with a pinch of salt and sugar. Toss 600g peeled green prawns with 1 tbsp chipotle sauce, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tbsp oil and grill 2 minutes a side. Char 2 corn cobs and cut off the kernels. Mix 150g sour cream with lime juice. Warm 12 small corn tortillas and fill with prawns, corn, crumbled feta, crema, onion and coriander.
W: Buttery cut-out sugar cookies with icing

Vanilla butter sugar cookies cut into stars, trees and reindeer, iced in red, green and white with a little edible glitter. Beat 200g butter with 100g icing sugar, add 1 egg yolk and 1 tsp vanilla, then mix in 300g plain flour. Chill 30 minutes. Roll to 5mm, cut out stars, trees and reindeer and bake at 170C for 12 minutes. Cool. Mix 250g icing sugar with 2 to 3 tbsp water, divide into 3 bowls and tint red and green, leaving one white. Ice the cookies and dust with edible glitter.
Dark and white chocolate bark with crushed peppermint candy canes

Layers of dark and white chocolate swirled together with peppermint, crushed candy canes and a pinch of sea salt, snapped into shards. Line a tray with baking paper. Melt 200g dark chocolate and spread into a 25 x 30cm rectangle. Chill 10 minutes. Melt 200g white chocolate with 1/4 tsp peppermint extract and spread over the dark layer, then drag a skewer through to swirl. Scatter with 5 crushed candy canes and a pinch of sea salt flakes. Chill 30 minutes until set and snap into shards.

S: Apple, celery, grapes and toasted walnuts in lemon mayo on crisp cos leaves

The old New York hotel salad, the kind of lunch Dorey Walker eats at her desk while the parade comes together. Toast 80g walnuts and chop roughly. Mix 100g mayonnaise, 100g Greek yoghurt, the juice of half a lemon, salt and pepper. Dice 3 crisp red apples and toss in the rest of the lemon juice. Slice 4 celery stalks and halve 150g red grapes. Fold everything through the dressing with most of the walnuts. Pile onto cos leaves and finish with the last walnuts and snipped chives.
M: Herb butter roast turkey breast with cornbread stuffing

Herb-butter roast turkey breast with cornbread stuffing, creamy mash, gravy and a bright cranberry orange relish. Push 60g herb butter under the skin of a 1.5kg turkey breast and roast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Crumble 300g cornbread with 1 fried onion, 2 celery sticks, 2 tbsp sage, 1 egg and 150ml stock and bake 30 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and milk. Simmer 150g cranberry sauce with orange zest. Make gravy from the juices with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.
W: New York pumpkin pie with maple cream
Pumpkin pie in a crisp crust, served with maple cream

Silky spiced pumpkin pie in a crisp pastry shell, topped with maple whipped cream and toasted pecans. Line a 23cm pie dish with 1 sheet shortcrust pastry and bake blind at 190C for 12 minutes. Steam 600g peeled pumpkin until soft, drain well and mash smooth. Beat with 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml cream, 2 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp ginger and a pinch of nutmeg. Pour into the case and bake at 170C for 45 minutes until just set. Cool. Whip 200ml cream with 2 tbsp maple syrup and serve with toasted pecans.
Ginger and cinnamon gingerbread with golden syrup

Soft spiced gingerbread cut into Santas, stars and toy soldiers, iced in white and red, the treats handed out in Santa's line. Melt 100g butter with 100g golden syrup and 80g brown sugar. Mix in 300g self-raising flour, 2 tsp ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon and 1 egg. Chill 30 minutes. Roll to 5mm, cut out shapes and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Cool. Mix 200g icing sugar with 2 tbsp water, tint a third red, and pipe on outlines and details.
K: Hot apple cider with maple, cinnamon, clove and orange

Cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves, star anise, orange and a little maple, served steaming with a cinnamon stick. Pour 1.2L cloudy apple juice into a saucepan with 2 tbsp maple syrup, 4 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 2 star anise and 1 sliced orange. Heat gently for 15 minutes without boiling so the spices infuse. Strain into 4 mugs and add a cinnamon stick and an orange slice to each.

S: Crisp baked wings glazed in sticky barbecue sauce

Sticky smoky barbecue wings with a sweet heat glaze, scattered with spring onion and served with a cool ranch dip. Toss 1.2kg chicken wings with 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika and salt. Bake on a rack at 220C for 40 minutes, turning once. Simmer 200ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp hot sauce for 3 minutes and toss the wings through, then bake 5 minutes more. Mix 100g sour cream, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, chopped chives and garlic powder for the ranch. Scatter wings with spring onion.
Mini bagels with cream cheese and everything seasoning

Toasted mini bagels with whipped spring onion cream cheese, crisp bacon and a sprinkle of homemade everything seasoning. Mix 1 tbsp sesame seeds, 1 tsp poppy seeds, 1 tsp dried onion flakes, 1/2 tsp garlic flakes and 1/2 tsp sea salt. Beat 200g cream cheese with 2 sliced spring onions until fluffy. Grill 4 rashers bacon until crisp and crumble. Split and toast 12 mini bagels. Spread with the cream cheese, top with bacon and sprinkle with the seasoning.

M: Mother's Day ham and spinach frittata
Baked frittata with ham, potato, spinach and feta

A thick oven-baked frittata of ham, spinach, potato and feta, served in wedges with a lemony rocket salad and tomato relish. Boil 300g diced potato for 8 minutes and drain. Fry 1 sliced onion in 1 tbsp oil in a 26cm ovenproof pan for 5 minutes, add the potato, 150g diced ham and 100g baby spinach and stir until wilted. Whisk 8 eggs with 100ml cream and salt, pour over and scatter with 100g crumbled feta. Cook on low for 5 minutes, then bake at 180C for 15 minutes until set. Serve with rocket dressed in lemon and relish.
Buttermilk fried chicken, waffles and hot maple

The Southern brunch plate that gets everyone through the big reveal, crisp chicken, soft waffles and a hot maple. Soak 8 chicken tenderloins in 250ml buttermilk with hot sauce and salt. Whisk 250g self-raising flour, 2 eggs, 300ml milk and 60g melted butter into a batter and cook in a hot waffle iron until crisp. Dredge the chicken in 150g flour with smoked paprika, salt and pepper and fry at 170C for 5 to 6 minutes. Warm 125ml maple syrup with a dash of hot sauce. Stack chicken on waffles, pour over the maple and serve with baby spinach dressed in lemon and oil.
W: Scones with balsamic strawberries and cream

Fluffy buttery shortcake biscuits split and filled with vanilla whipped cream and balsamic macerated strawberries. Slice 300g strawberries and toss with 1 tbsp caster sugar and 1 tsp balsamic vinegar and leave 20 minutes. Rub 80g cold butter into 250g self-raising flour and 2 tbsp sugar, add 150ml milk and pat out to 2cm. Cut 6 rounds, brush with milk and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Whip 300ml cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar and 1 tsp vanilla. Split the shortcakes and fill with cream and strawberries.

M: Nick's chicken souvlaki and village salad
Lemon oregano chicken skewers, pita and horiatiki

Toula's brother Nick on the grill out the back of Dancing Zorba's, making enough for the whole family and then some. Marinate 800g chicken thigh chunks in the juice of a lemon, 3 tbsp olive oil, 3 garlic cloves, 2 tsp oregano and salt for at least 1 hour. Thread onto skewers and grill 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred. Grate half a cucumber into 200g Greek yoghurt with lemon and salt. Cut the rest of the cucumber, 3 tomatoes, half a red onion and a green capsicum into chunks, add olives and a slab of feta, and dress with oil and oregano. Warm 4 pitas on the grill.
Gus's front-yard lamb with lemon potatoes
the lamb turning on a spit on the front lawn when Ian's parents come to meet the family

Butterflied lamb leg in lemon, garlic and oregano, charred on the barbecue, with roasted Greek lemon potatoes. Mix 80ml olive oil, the juice of 2 lemons, 4 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tbsp dried oregano and 1 tsp salt, rub all over a 1.8kg butterflied lamb leg and marinate in the fridge for 2 hours. Heat the oven to 220C. Toss 1.2kg potato wedges in a roasting tin with 60ml olive oil, the juice of 2 lemons, 2 sliced garlic cloves and 1 tsp oregano, pour in 250ml chicken stock and roast for 1 hour, turning twice, until golden and the liquid has gone. Meanwhile heat a barbecue to high and cook the lamb for 10 to 12 minutes a side until charred outside and pink inside, then rest under foil for 15 minutes. Carve thickly and serve with the potatoes and pan juices.
